$description: Sassy design tokens in the DTCG format (Format Module 2025.10). Generated from tokens/*.css: the CSS is the source, edit that, not this file.

color.$description: The base palette. Warm stone neutrals do almost all the work; moss is the one living colour. The same in every mode.

lichen.$description: Accent, use sparingly. Also the text-selection highlight.

mascot.$description: The mascot. Sussi is always black and white; dark mode adds a thin halo (.s-sussi).

size.$description: Scale (px), minor third-ish, tuned by hand.

typography.$description: The type roles, as the CSS font shorthand (--type-*) carries them. letterSpacing is what base.css sets on the headings; the shorthand cannot carry it.

theme.$description: The semantic tokens, with the same paths under light and dark. Light is the default (:root) and moss the accent.

3.$description: text on it is --fg-2 or darker: --fg-3 is 4.06:1 here (4.31 in dark) and only carries non-text marks, such as the switch thumb ring
4.56:1 on surface-2, 4.89:1 on bg. stone-500 was 3.3–3.75:1

control.$description: edge of inputs, checkboxes and the off switch: ≥ 3:1 on every surface (1.4.11). border-strong was 1.56:1

focus.$description: the outline on :focus-visible, ≥ 3:1 on every surface

fg-on.$description: text on a --danger fill (the danger button), also while hovered: ≥ 4.5:1 on --danger and --danger-hover

shadow.$description: Warm-tinted, low and diffuse. Borders carry most structure; shadow only means "lifted".
Deeper black shadows plus a hairline white ring.

accent.$description: The per-app accent layer (<html data-accent="...">): the same paths under every accent and mode. Moss is the system default and aliases the theme; the others override what the CSS overrides and alias the theme for the rest.

text.$description: ≥ 4.6:1 on every surface (#A65B3C was 4.41:1 on --surface-2), and not --accent-hover, so a link changes colour on hover

fjord.$description: Fjord is also info; info stays a soft fill.

text.$description: ≥ 4.6:1 on every surface (fjord-500 was 4.34:1 on --surface-2), and not --accent-hover

lichen.$description: Lichen-500 is too light for text, so the accent is lichen-700.

text.$description: ≥ 4.6:1 on every surface (lichen-700 was 4.28:1 on --surface-2), and not --accent-hover

lyng.$description: Ochre and brick are taken by warning and danger, so lyng is its own family.

ochre.$description: Ochre is also warning, so the accent is a deeper ochre that holds 4.5:1; warnings stay soft fills.
